summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, building Python and ROS 2 robotics tooling validated on real hardware. Built a LeRobot-structured multi-camera data collection pipeline for a robotic arm and debugged 11 integration failures across its Jetson and Arduino stack, including stale-frame capture. Wrote a coordinate-frame visualizer with an SE(3) math engine and a real-time data acquisition GUI.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom toothbrush detection dataset of 1,133 images; trained YOLOv8n to 83% mAP@50 and exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Debugged 11 integration failures across the sensor-to-actuator pipeline (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.
Built a LeRobot-structured data collection pipeline using multiprocessing for multi-camera frame capture.
Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided pick-and-place system: Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller over a WebSocket fabric.
Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms) for visual servoing and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors (gripper-ToF-triggered close at 25 mm) via TCA9548A I2C mux.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and hand-computed full forward kinematic chains (0T6) for a 6-DoF UR5e and a 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF models in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic.
Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on physical UR5e via UR ROS 2 driver; AL5B repeatability measured at <2mm over 10 trials.

projects.name: Frame Simulator — Desktop 3D Coordinate-Frame Visualizer
bullets: Built a PySide6/Qt desktop GUI with an OpenGL-backed VisPy 3D viewport to visualize coordinate-frame hierarchies, parent-child transform chains, and SE(3) poses in real time.
Wrote a custom DSL parser and SE(3) math engine supporting local/world rotation and translation composition, recursive world-transform chaining, and live 4x4 matrix inspection per frame.
